items.observation: The 18-test file does not use fakeAsync; it verifies that the hedge delay triggers with real 5-120 ms sleeps (about a 2x margin). Four sibling files use fake_async. Ordering can slip on a slow CI runner; flake frequency was not measured.
items.proposed_fix: Rewrite the tests with `fakeAsync((async) { ... async.elapse(...) })`; keep the Completer-controlled `ControlledAction`.
items.closure_criteria: Every timing assertion in hedge_fallback_test runs inside fakeAsync with async.elapse and keeps the Completer-driven ControlledAction. The file contains no wall-clock sleep and the full file passes.

items.proposed_fix: A single private helper (`StateError _disposedError()`) or a constant message.
items.closure_criteria: rate_limiter.dart builds the disposed StateError in one private helper or one constant message. rate_limiter_test still passes.
